thread:
maria_cs: Wellspring sent a vendor questionnaire and wants concrete answers for DPA + SOC2 evidence, plus details on KMS/CMEK for embeddings and a dataflow diagram. They're asking what data we persist and what we can expose in a dataroom.

sam_engineering: quick q — is Wellspring on Hosted or Dedicated? CMEK only applies to Private/Dedicated, not hosted.

maria_cs: Hosted today, evaluating Dedicated for compliance. They still want to see encryption-at-rest details and retention for embeddings produced during evaluation.

jess_legal: we can share a redacted SOC2 report and a standard DPA. Need to confirm whether they require contractual CMEK (customer-managed keys) or just documentation of our KMS controls. If CMEK is requested, that's an enterprise/legal addendum + infra work.

owen_security: high-level answers we can give now: AES-256 for at-rest, TLS1.2+ for in-transit, access via RBAC, audit logs retained per retention policy. For Hosted: keys are managed by Redwood (AWS KMS/GCP KMS) and we can provide key rotation cadence and HSM attestations. For Dedicated/Private: we support customer-managed keys (CMEK) — integration depends on cloud provider.

security-bot: Incident report available: none in last 12 months for key management services. :white_check_mark:

sam_engineering: technical note to include in reply (suggested):
```
- Embeddings storage: saved encrypted at rest in S3 or equivalent, keys via KMS.
- Retention: default 30 days for ephemeral evals, configurable up to customer SLA.
- Access: only infra/service accounts with least privilege can access KV and blob stores; access is logged.
- Model interaction: input text may be cached for prefix caching but is not persisted beyond retention unless customer opts in.
```

jess_legal: also ask them for a scope doc: what environments (prod/test), whether they want vendor attestations redacted, and the exact subprocessors they need listed. We'll prep the DPA + redacted SOC2 and list of subprocessors.

maria_cs: Plan: I'll reply to Wellspring by EOD with 1) a redacted SOC2, 2) our standard DPA draft, 3) a short tech appendix from Sam/Owen (use the snippet above), and 4) a note about CMEK being possible only on Dedicated/Private with an addendum. Tagging owners: @sam_engineering (tech appendix), @jess_legal (DPA + contract questions), @owen_security (logs + attestation).

sam_engineering: I'll produce a 1-page dataflow diagram and a one-paragraph KMS integration note by tomorrow morning.

owen_security: I'll pull KMS rotation + KMS audit sample and attach. Also confirm what we can include in the dataroom (redacted audit logs, SOC2 PDF).

maria_cs: thanks — I'll send the customer draft and cc legal once we have the attachments. Wellspring asked for a timeline of 3 business days; I'll push for 48 hours but marking 72h as realistic. :calendar:

jess_legal: OK. If they push for CMEK on Hosted we should escalate to sales/eng infra — that'll need procurement/legal + infra lead.

maria_cs: noted. I'm going to upload the redacted SOC2 and DPA to the shared dataroom once we have the tech appendix. Will follow up here after send. :thumbsup:
